results.what: the scale is (signed byte * multiplier) >> 7, rounding downwards, for a multiplier under 128
scale is (operand >> 1) - 1 and centre is the operand, for each axis
the projection is exactly DIV then SCALE then the centre, everywhere strictly inside the frustum
on the frustum edge, where the quotient is exactly 1, it comes back one short
